description: Image Description: The image shows a bathroom toilet with its tank lid removed, exposing the internal components of the tank. The toilet is peach-colored, with a white seat and lid that are closed. Inside the tank, visible rust and mineral deposits suggest long-term water exposure and possible neglect or aging plumbing. The flush mechanism, including the flapper valve, fill valve, and connecting pipes, is visible. A black plastic component, possibly part of the flush lever system, is also present.
